rows.question: What does error E-4021 mean?

answer.answer: E-4021 means "Sync conflict": the same file was changed on two devices before either change finished syncing. CloudSync keeps both versions, renaming the second one with the suffix "(conflicted copy, device name)". To resolve it, open the Conflict Resolver from the tray icon, compare the two versions, and choose Keep Both, Keep Local, or Keep Cloud.

citations.quote: The same file was changed on two devices before either change finished syncing. CloudSync keeps both versions.

rows.question: I keep getting E-4032 when uploading. What should I do?

answer.answer: E-4032 means your account has used all of its storage. To fix it, free up space by emptying the trash, or upgrade to a plan with more storage. Uploads will resume automatically once space is available.

citations.quote: Your account has used all of its storage. Free up space by emptying the trash, or upgrade to a plan with more storage.
